title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Note on the Statement Hazard Disbursement
content:
# Statement hazard disbursement — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the statement hazard disbursement enters the retention statement balance. It rests on the set-aside held under the Set-Aside Accounts product that pays the loan's property charges.

The statement hazard disbursement is the statement bill of type hazard insurance bill limited to the set-aside's set-aside balance less its statement bill of type property tax bill, not below 0.00, when that set-aside is a Fully Funded LESA, and that hazard bill in full when it is a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve; a loan with no such bill or no such set-aside carries nothing (0.00).

A statement bill is, for each of property tax bill, hazard insurance bill and flood insurance bill, the received bill of that type with the latest due date on the set-aside that pays the loan's property charges, an active Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory), an active Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) or an active Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, when its payment date falls no later than 30 calendar days after the statement date; a bill's payment date is its due date less the set-aside plan's tax payment lead days for a tax bill and less its insurance payment lead days for a hazard or flood bill. Where several such bills of one type share that latest due date, their billed amounts are taken together as that type's bill. The 30 days are the plan's good-through period.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical Fully Funded LESA

| Hypothetical input | Amount |
|---|---|
| Set-aside balance | USD 1500.00 |
| Tax statement bill | USD 1100.00 |
| Hazard statement bill | USD 700.00 |
| Balance left after the tax statement bill | USD 400.00 |
| Statement hazard disbursement | USD 400.00 |

With a tax statement bill of USD 1800.00 instead, the balance left would fall below zero and is taken as 0.00, so the statement hazard disbursement is 0.00. On a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve the hazard statement bill of USD 700.00 is carried in full. The amounts are invented for the illustration.
